lines.text: Watch this red box. Soon it turns green.
This is ZoneGuard A I, monitoring presence live. That box marks one desk as a zone.
Nobody is in the chair yet, so the zone reads inactive, and the counter at the top says so too.
Now he takes the chair. Red turns green, and the counters and the status switch to active.
Active and inactive time are tracked per workstation. Each zone runs a timer of its own, and zones are unlimited.
When more than one person is detected at a workstation, an alert comes with a snapshot. The alerts page lists each one.
Each alert carries its screenshot, and an operator marks it acknowledged. That leaves a clear audit trail.
In Configuration, set the detection threshold on a confidence slider, and choose whether the live feed shows a box and an ID label on each person.
Shift start and shift end are set here too, and monitoring is only active during shift hours.
New users are added from one short form, each with a role.
ZoneGuard A I, by Sytronsoft. Visit sytronsoft dot com, or mail info at sytronsoft dot com.
